stem: Entering the teachers’ office each morning, it’s polite to:
options: Walk past silently
Greet colleagues with a nod or a quick “早安/早”
Wait to be greeted first
Knock loudly before entering
why: 進辦公室時點頭或說聲「早安」是常見的基本禮貌，同事間會這樣互相打招呼。
zh: 每天早上進辦公室時的禮貌習慣。

stem: If a senior teacher or the principal offers you food at a school event, it’s best to:
options: Firmly refuse every time
Ask for a different dish
Take the largest portion
Accept graciously, even just a small amount
why: 直接拒絕可能顯得不給面子，即使不餓，禮貌性地接受一點會更得體。
zh: 資深老師或校長在活動中請你吃東西時。

stem: Regarding indoor shoes on many Taiwanese school campuses, foreign teachers should:
options: Change into slippers wherever the school requires it
Always keep outdoor shoes on everywhere
Go barefoot indoors
Ignore posted signage about shoes
why: 許多校舍入口有換室內拖鞋的規定，看到鞋櫃或標示就要換鞋。
zh: 關於校園室內鞋規定。

stem: When receiving a gift or a business card from a colleague, it’s respectful to:
options: Accept with one hand while looking away
Put it straight in your pocket
Accept with both hands
Politely decline it
why: 雙手接遞物品是台灣（及許多亞洲文化）表達尊重的常見方式。
zh: 從同事手中接過名片或禮物時。

stem: You disagree with a decision made by school administration. The culturally appropriate first step is:
options: Announce your disagreement in the staff group chat
Raise it privately and respectfully with your contact teacher
Ignore the policy going forward
Post about it on social media
why: 私下、尊重地先跟窗口老師反映，是比較合適且能保留雙方顏面的做法。
zh: 對學校行政決定有不同意見時。

stem: During a flag-raising ceremony (升旗), foreign teachers are generally expected to:
options: Stay inside the office
Continue teaching class as usual
Leave campus
Stand respectfully with staff and students
why: 升旗是全校共同參與的儀式，教師通常會與班級一起站著參加。
zh: 升旗典禮時，外師通常被期待。

stem: When addressing your homeroom partner teacher in front of students, it’s best to use:
options: Their title, e.g. “Teacher Chen” (老師)
Their first name only
A nickname you created
“Hey you”
why: 在學生面前使用「老師」加姓氏，示範了學生本身對老師應有的稱呼方式。
zh: 在學生面前稱呼你的班級導師時。

stem: A parent sends a red envelope (紅包) or an expensive gift after a holiday. The safest response is:
options: Accept and say nothing to the school
Ask for more next time
Politely decline and check your school’s gift policy
Return it by mail with no note
why: 許多學校對收受家長禮物有規範，不確定時最好婉拒並告知窗口老師。
zh: 節日後收到家長送的紅包或貴重禮物時。

stem: You’re walking down a hallway and pass the principal or a senior teacher. The polite habit is to:
options: Avoid eye contact and keep walking
Wait for them to speak first, always
Only greet them if you know them well
Give a small nod or brief greeting as you pass
why: 經過時點頭或簡短問候，是同事間表達基本尊重的習慣動作。
zh: 在走廊遇到校長或資深老師時。

stem: For a class or duty that starts at a set time, the expected norm is to arrive:
options: Right on the minute it starts
A few minutes early
A few minutes late is fine
Whenever convenient
why: 提早幾分鐘到場被視為基本的準時與尊重，而不是壓線抵達。
zh: 對於有固定開始時間的課程或值勤。

stem: At a school event, staff are asked to gather for a big group photo. The expected norm is to:
options: Stay at your desk and skip it
Join only if photographed for something specific
Join in — group photos are a normal part of school culture
Ask to be edited out afterward
why: 團體合照是台灣校園活動很常見的一環，教職員通常都會一起入鏡。
zh: 學校活動要求全體教職員合照時。

stem: You’re invited to a staff dinner (聚餐) after a busy semester. It’s considered polite to:
options: Attend, even just for part of it, if you reasonably can
Decline all staff social invitations
Only attend if food is free
Bring your own separate meal
why: 即使只能待一部分時間，盡量出席聚餐有助於融入同事間的情誼。
zh: 學期結束後受邀參加同事聚餐時。

stem: At a staff dinner, you notice colleagues topping up each other’s drinks. The custom being followed is:
options: Pouring only for yourself
Waiting for the host to pour every glass
Refusing to let anyone pour for you
Filling others’ cups before your own as a small gesture of care
why: 先幫別人倒滿再倒自己的，是聚餐場合中常見的體貼小舉動。
zh: 聚餐時發現同事會互相幫忙倒飲料。

stem: A student is having a serious personal or family problem. The appropriate step is to:
options: Discuss it openly in front of the class
Quietly refer it to the homeroom teacher or counselor
Post about it in the staff group chat
Handle discipline yourself without involving anyone else
why: 涉及學生隱私與家庭狀況的議題，應私下轉知導師或輔導老師處理。
zh: 學生有嚴重的個人或家庭問題時。

stem: You have feedback about how the school is run. The most effective and respectful channel is to:
options: Post it publicly online first
Bring it up loudly in a full staff meeting
Share it privately through your contact teacher or supervisor
Wait until your contract ends to mention it
why: 透過窗口老師或主管私下反映，通常比公開場合更有效也更受尊重。
zh: 對學校運作有建議或想法時。

stem: During the national anthem or a formal school ceremony, foreign teachers are expected to:
options: Stand quietly and respectfully like other staff
Continue any side conversations
Use the time to check their phone
Step outside until it’s over
why: 和其他教職員一樣安靜肅立，是參加正式典禮時應有的態度。
zh: 國歌演奏或正式典禮進行時。

stem: For a formal school event (e.g. opening ceremony, official visit), appropriate attire is:
options: Whatever is most comfortable
Beachwear if the weather is hot
Costume or novelty clothing
Conservative, professional dress similar to other staff
why: 正式場合建議穿著與其他教職員相近的端莊服裝，展現對場合的重視。
zh: 參加開學典禮或官方參訪等正式場合時的服裝。

stem: When speaking with a student’s parent for the first time, it’s respectful to address them as:
options: By their first name only
With an appropriate title (e.g. Mr./Mrs., or 家長) rather than their first name
“Hey”
Their child’s nickname for them
why: 使用適當的稱謂而非直呼名字，是對家長表達禮貌與尊重的方式。
zh: 第一次與學生家長交談時的稱呼方式。

stem: A colleague makes a small mistake in front of others. The culturally sensitive approach is to:
options: Address it privately and gently rather than correcting them publicly
Point it out immediately in front of the group
Post about it afterward to other coworkers
Bring it up loudly to make sure everyone learns from it
why: 私下溫和地提醒能顧全對方的面子，公開糾正容易造成尷尬或不快。
zh: 同事在他人面前犯了小錯時。

stem: Overall, when you’re unsure whether something is culturally appropriate at your school, the best move is to:
options: Guess and hope for the best
Assume it’s the same as back home
Ask your contact teacher or a trusted colleague
Avoid the situation entirely going forward
why: 直接詢問窗口老師或信任的同事，永遠比自己猜測更保險。
zh: 不確定某件事在學校是否合乎文化習慣時。
